hooks.command: printf 'Follow this overlay entrypoint and all files it requires. Local checkout: %s\n' "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; cat "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/AGENTS.md"

hooks.prompt: Before writing files: Verify this change follows the coding standards (no console.log, use unknown instead of any, interfaces prefixed with 'I', handle null/undefined explicitly, use braces for void arrow functions).
Before running bash: Use MSYS2 bash terminal, not PowerShell. Use POSIX-compliant sh syntax. Prefer awk over grep.

Before finishing, follow skills/self-audit/SKILL.md from the selected overlay source. Apply only relevant and authorized checks. Report unavailable checks or delivery steps accurately; do not claim unverified success.
